topic: Deferred-interest "same as cash" financing -- miss the payoff date by a day and months of interest hit retroactively
title: The 'No Interest' Deal That Costs You Hundreds
description:
That 'same as cash' or 'no interest for 12 months' deal has a trap hidden in the fine print. If you miss the payoff date by a single day, you could owe all the interest from day one.

#personalfinance #creditcard #debt
